system: A board paper as a page: a tested kernel computes the cost comparison, the compliance map for the modelled bank's AI workloads and a sealed go/no-go board in the browser from committed, sourced data. The page runs no model and collects nothing; it keeps only its theme in the browser.

aiAct.why: No AI system (Art 3(1)): the build runs no model that infers its outputs, so the AI Act places no duty on it.

gdpr.why: No personal data is processed, so no GDPR / UK GDPR duty arises from the build.
